dimensions.question: What responsibility the source contributes to this cluster.
Methods, phases, tools, or templates contributed by the source.
Inputs consumed and artifacts or decisions produced.

Tools, mutation authority, external effects, and consent boundaries.

fusion_rules.rule: Identify an AI product wedge, defensible application layer, and model-curve-aware opportunity before committing to architecture.
Accept only: A validated customer problem, workflow friction, model trajectory, data advantage, and business constraint.
Produce only: An AI opportunity thesis, wedge choice, defensibility hypothesis, and feasibility questions.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

input_boundary: A validated customer problem, workflow friction, model trajectory, data advantage, and business constraint.
output_boundary: An AI opportunity thesis, wedge choice, defensibility hypothesis, and feasibility questions.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 通过行业垂直化和领域知识避开与基础模型正面竞争。; 从客户需要的具体 superpower 出发，让专门团队 prototype 和 pilot。; 面向预期模型能力规划产品，避免堆积将被基础模型吸收的定制 scaffolding。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 只贴行业标签不构成结构优势。; 没有客户信号时先发现问题。; 用于路线图假设；12–18 个月是来源预测，不是已实现能力。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 8 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (gate=1, method=4, rule=3); each is bound to an exact source citation.
